pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against adding positions when volatility exceeds the 20-period ATR median; zero averaging down into falling knives.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory ATR-based buffer filter enforcing a minimum stop distance of at least 1.5x the current spread plus short-term noise variance, entirely forbidding sub-dollar mechanical stops on XAUUSD.
profit_harvest_threshold: Trigger trailing sentinel harvests once floating profit crosses +$10.00 to lock in gains and prevent evaporation toward breakeven.
